name: State of Charge (SoC) Window
description: Battery SoC must remain within safe operational bounds (10% to 100%).
violation_msg: Battery SoC ({carState.soc}%) violates allowed window of 10%-100%.

name: Kinetic Energy Recovery Limit
description: Maximum MGU-K energy recovery per lap cannot exceed 2.0 MJ.
violation_msg: Energy recovered this lap ({carState.energyRecovered_MJ} MJ) exceeds regulatory limit of 2.0 MJ.

name: Deployment Power Limit
description: Max deployment is capped at 120kW under normal conditions.
violation_msg: Requested deployment power ({recommendation.power_kW} kW) exceeds normal limit of 120kW.

name: Overtake Override Eligibility
description: Overtake modes (>120kW) are only permitted when trailing gap is <= 1.0s.
violation_msg: Override active but gap to leading car ({carState.leadingCarGap_s}s) exceeds DRS 1.0s threshold.
